Maya (Support): Heads up — customer ACME reported that the token cost heatmap and org cost card are showing $0 or NaN for several sub-orgs after last night's usage-join migration. They hit this in EU region. Can we triage? :warning:
Dan (EngOncall): Thanks, pinging eng-infra. Do we have org IDs and an example org that reproduces?
Maya (Support): Provided org IDs in DM: org_9801, org_9802. Screenshot attached in thread (heatmap cells read NaN). They say API billing calls look normal.
Suzi (Analytics): I ran a quick read from the aggregated_costs table for org_9801: returned rows where unit_cost = NaN and total_tokens = 0. Query I ran:```sql
SELECT org_id, date, total_tokens, unit_cost, total_cost
FROM aggregated_costs
WHERE org_id = 'org_9801'
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Result snippet: `| org_9801 | 2026-03-16 | 0 | NaN | NaN |`
Dan (EngOncall): Interesting — ingestion pipeline computes unit_cost = sum(cost_tokens)/sum(billed_tokens). If billed_tokens is zero after the join with usage_partitions, we end up with division by zero and produce NaN. Looks like the left join with usage_partitions after migration isn't defaulting missing billed_tokens to 0.
Lina (Billing): If we output NaN to the dashboard it displays as NaN/blank. For billing we need explicit zeros, otherwise ledger joins break. Is this only for orgs with no usage buckets?
Suzi (Analytics): Yes, scope seems limited to orgs that had no ingested token rows in the new partitioning scheme. The join key changed from (org,date,region) to (org,period,region) in migration — rows that didn't have matching period rows end up NULLs.
Ravi (PM): Priority? Customers impacted: ACME (support ticket #4621) and 2 other enterprise accounts. This will look bad in console. Recommend hotfix + backfill.
Dan (EngOncall): Quick mitigation: update the aggregation SQL to coalesce(billed_tokens,0) and coalesce(total_cost,0.0) before dividing. That prevents NaN. Patch prepared:```diff
- unit_cost = sum(cost_tokens) / sum(billed_tokens)
+ unit_cost = sum(cost_tokens) / nullif(sum(coalesce(billed_tokens,0)),0)
```
That still returns NULL when billed_tokens==0, so downstream we coalesce(unit_cost,0.0). Will push to staging now.
deploy-bot: Deploy started to staging (deploy-4567) :rocket:
Dan (EngOncall): Pushed fix to staging, dashboard renders zeros now for org_9801. Going to run backfill for the last 30 days. Backfill plan: run corrected aggregation job over affected partitions, mark rows with backfilled=true.
Suzi (Analytics): Backfill query ready. Will run a dry-run, then apply. Dry-run shows ~1.2k rows with NaN across orgs in EU region.
Lina (Billing): After backfill we should re-run ledger reconciliations for the affected invoices. I'll coordinate with finance.
Maya (Support): Notified ACME that we’re investigating and will update in 2h. They asked for public ETA.
Ravi (PM): ETA: hotfix to prod in 90m after verification in staging, backfill in next maintenance window (2am UTC) unless we need immediate fix.
Dan (EngOncall): Patch scheduled for prod deploy in 1h. Post-deploy steps: verify dashboard heatmap and token-cost tile for sample orgs (org_9801, org_9802, org_1234). Re-check monitoring alerts for ingestion errors.
Suzi (Analytics): Adding a unit test for the aggregation logic to catch null/zero denominators going forward. Also will add a dashboard tile showing % of org-days with null costs so we detect regressions.
Lina (Billing): Filing internal ticket to ensure invoices already generated for impacted days are rechecked.
Maya (Support): ACME updated: appreciates fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy to prod succeeded (deploy-4570) :white_check_mark:
Dan (EngOncall): Verified prod — heatmap zeros showing as $0.00 for the sample orgs, no NaNs. Kicking off backfill now.
Suzi (Analytics): Backfill completed for 30 days. I can confirm aggregated_costs rows now have numeric zeros instead of NaN.
Lina (Billing): Reconciliations re-run, no unbilled gaps remain for affected invoices.
Maya (Support): Closing the support ticket after customer confirmation. Thanks all. :tada:
Ravi (PM): Follow-ups: add migration checklist item to validate join keys, add aggregation unit tests, and monitor null-cost metric.
Dan (EngOncall): Filed follow-up PRs and created a postmortem doc link in #postmortems.
Maya (Support): Closing thread.
